Abercrombie.notes: Bad. Even for low-oil purposes, which monitors (BMs) aren't used often for, Abercrombie is the worst BM.

Admiral Nakhimov.notes: One of the highest damage ships against medium armor, she also has good damage against heavy armor enemies. When she launches an airstrike, she slows the enemies from 1.5s after her airstrike to 6.5s after. If the enemy is slowed by another Northern Parliament ship, then the period from 1.5s to 4.0s becomes a freeze. Nakhimov also gains +40% crit damage against enemies slowed by other NP ships, which is worth about 10% more damage. This makes her somewhat dependent on being run with another Nothern Parliment ship that can slow enemies (usually Soyuz or Moskva). These tiers and damage ratings assume that there is no such slow in the fleet. See Nakhimov's pairing for an idea of how she performs with a good Northern Parliament ship who has a slow.

When Admiral Nakhimov launches an airstrike, she slows the enemies from 1.5s after her airstrike to 6.5s after. If the enemy is slowed by another Northern Parliament ship, then the period from 1.5s to 4.0s becomes a freeze. Nakhimov also gains +40% crit damage against enemies slowed by other NP ships, and this is worth about 10% more damage. Thus, her tiers and damage ratings assume that Moskva's permanent or Soyuz's 6 second slow is active for the whole period from 1.5s after Nakhimov's airstrike until Nakhimov's payload hits. For the Offense Buff, she is credited with a freeze, but she only turns slow into freeze.

Admiral Zenker.notes: Standard top-level gold BB for 2025, less personal dmg than top gold BBs but has solid buffs.

Akagi.notes: Should use Echoes of Relinquished Time instead of Catapult for more damage. Not assumed, but can be paired with Kaga or Kaga (BB) to make Akagi as strong as Akagi μ.

Akagi μ.notes: Assume there are 3 muse ships in the fleet for 30% AVI. Ships can use Cosmic Kicks or Celestial Body to be considered as muse ships.

Akagi-chan.notes: One-time barrage requires 3 IJN, but it's not too important.

Akane Shinjo.notes: Her summon may draw or block a little fire, otherwise she's just decent pure damage.

Akashi.notes: Minor heals both inside and outside battle, and +1 ammo is very nice for mob.

Alabama.notes: Needs mob ramp up in a sortie, but also does acceptable damage against single bosses.

Albion.notes: Assume there are 3 Royal Navy ships for 10% AVI.

Alsace.notes: One of the best all around UR BBs in the game currently. She has good damage output against all armor types with a preload (however her damage on a per slavo basis is somewhat weaker compared to other UR BBs) and she’s one of the few BBs with salvo capacity +1 so she isn’t affected by absolute cooldowns making her quicker to reload her main guns in practice compared to other BBs. Her barrage can also incflict a 12% damage debuff on enemies it hits for 10 seconds. She also has a zombie heal when one of the ships in your fleet falls below 30% HP. Alsace doesn’t have any real weaknesses persay but she’s not the absolute best at any one thing.

Alvitr.notes: Has a focused single-"shell" barrage, so a miss or a shield and her damage drops significantly.

Amagi.notes: Prefers 4 IJN ships, not assumed here.

Amagi(CV).notes: Amagi(CV) buffs all Sakura Empire torpedoes, including those from torpedo bombers, by 15%. This focus on TBs skews her against heavy armor bosses. Although she can do damage solo, she prefers to be paired with other Sakura Empire CV(s) to buff their TBs and receive their buffs. She also applies permanent debuffs stacking up to -9% stats to enemies, and these stats improve your fleet's offense by a slight amount and survivability by more. Put Amagi not in the flagship position to squeeze 0.5% more damage out of her distance skill.

Assumed to be with Shinano or Hakuhou. Amagi(CV) buffs all Sakura Empire torpedoes, including those from torpedo bombers, by 15%. This focus on TBs skews her against heavy armor bosses. She also applies permanent debuffs stacking up to -9% stats to enemies, and these stats improve your fleet's offense by a slight amount and survivability by more. Put Amagi not in the flagship position to squeeze 0.5% more damage out of her distance skill.

An Shan.notes: Not assumed, but can buff An Shan class.

Andrea Doria.notes: Has a small buff for Sardegna Empire ships and prefers to have another Sardegna BB in the fleet. Assume that she is buffing several Sardegna ships.

Andrea Doria META.notes: Assuming there is another META ship for +10% dmg.

Anniversary Kizuna AI.notes: Not assumed, but requires another Kizuna AI ship for Assault Carrier.

Aquila.notes: Aquila equips a dive bomber in her second slot to gain a preloaded airstrike and do more damage. The preload for fast farming is the only thing she's good for in this mode.
Secondary healer. Aquila equips a fighter in her second slot to heal and protect the lowest HP% ship in both vanguard and main fleet.

Secondary healer. Aquila equips a fighter in her second slot to heal and protect the lowest HP% ship in both vanguard and main fleet. This makes her a great pair with Musashi for tanking all forms of damage to your main fleet.

Arizona META.notes: Bugged only 50% slow but still very good for defending against ramming ships. Has a large timeable one-time debuff for EX if you left her at level 1 for some reason.

Ark Royal.notes: Slow with very generous timing. But it's not a freeze.

Arkhangelsk.notes: Assumes there are 3 Royal Navy or Northern Parliament ships for 15% FP.

August von Parseval.notes: Freeze. Strongly prefers a KMS plane. Bonus damage against CL/CA, worse buff against heavy.

BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER.notes: Generic good new SR BB/BC for 2025.

Bataan.notes: Should use F6F Hellcat when not using rocket fighters.

Bismarck.notes: Assumed to be buffing multiple KMS ships. So Bismarck is still bad unless the buffed ships are super strong.

Bismarck Zwei.notes: One of the best all around UR BBs in the game currently. She has good damage output against all armor types on top of a 3 second black hole which can pull enemies together and root them in place. The duration of the black hole is a bit on the short side though so if you want to take full advantage if it your syncing needs to very tight. Other than that, she doesn’t have any real weaknesses persay but she’s not the absolute best at any one thing. Note though it’s not accounted for her ratings she can also run the auxiliary Certificate of Sponsorship which reduces the Out of Ammo debuff for your main fleet by 15%.

Bogue.notes: Augment is a good boost, but not enough to show in this scale.

Bois Belleau.notes: First airstrike is staggered, but further ones may be close to Unicorn. Prefers USS or Iris plane.

Centaur.notes: Assumes there are 3 Royal Navy ships for 10% more damage. Delayed slow. Needs to launch airstrike before other main fleet ships.

Chihaya Kisaragi.notes: Not assumed because there's no good candidate, but an iM@S pairing gives a bonus.

Chitose.notes: Not assumed, but can sortie with another IJN CVL to double her barrage damage. Needs to launch airstrike before other main fleet ships to buff them.

Chiyoda.notes: Not assumed, but can sortie with another IJN CVL to double her barrage damage.

Duke of York.notes: Requires high-damage (UR) teammates to be good. Requires faster gun/radar to fire before said UR BB teammates.

Dunkerque META.notes: Preload but only 2 MGM. Small heal if multiple enemies.

Enterprise.notes: For an average 70% proc rate, she is high gold CV level. With 100% rate, rainbow CV damage (but no support).

Essex.notes: Essex is a jack of all trades, master of none relative to other rainbow ships. She doesn't really have any strong synergies, but on the bright side, that means she fits well in any fleet as a transitional option. Although not assumed for these ratings, she slightly prefers to be with Eagle Union carriers for 5% AVI each. She is also one of the best support fleet carriers in late campaign.

Being in a fleet with Kearsarge, Yorktown II, and/or Lexington II massively buffs Essex but limits her to light armor bosses. In such a fleet, Essex only does damage and doesn't buff the fleet. That, combined with her lower anti-light damage relative to other Eagle Union UR CVs, makes her a transitional option.

Flandre.notes: Alsace at home. High gold BB level for 80s or 90s bossing.

Formidable.notes: Freeze is hard to use. Needs HMS gear.

Formidable μ.notes: Assumes there are 3 muse ships for a preload. Ships can equip Cosmic Kicks or Celestial Body to be considered as muse ships.

Francesco Caracciolo.notes: zTENTATIVE Heals herself, decent damage but 80% barrage is inconsistent.

Franklin.notes: About equal to 70% proc Enterprise in bossing. Assumes there is another Eagle Union main fleet ship for 10% damage.

Friedrich der Große.notes: One of the oldest Rainbows in the game, and unfortunately it shows. She’s the weakest of the UR BBs in damage across all 3 armor types except Vanguard, and she doesn’t have any equivalent to Vanguard’s massive damage buffs and debuff to compensate. And to top it all off to reach her damage potential as shown in her ratings she needs to consistently take damage and/or have enemies nearby to proc her proxy barrage. Her wide barrages however do still make her an above average choice for W14 though even there she has been powercrept pretty hard.

Fritz Rumey.notes:
Arguably the most flexible of the UR carriers, she is excellent against light and medium armor bosses thanks to her ability to equip 8 fighters (or 4 fighters and 4 Skyraiders). This also enables her to more easily get off 4 airstrikes in 80 seconds META showdowns compared to other carriers without gimping her damage too much. Her main weakness is that she’s more reliant on having good equipment (even compared to other carriers) and, to a lesser extent, tech to get the most out of her, since she only has 2 aircraft slots, each of which consists of 4 aircraft and getting HVARs, Skyraiders, and La-9s in quantity isn’t that easy. She's also the best ship for W15 and W16 support fleets. 
 Also strongest w15 support.

She also does about 9% more damage for every other Sakura Empire main fleet ship who reloads at roughly the same time as her. These ratings assume that there is one other Sakura Empire main fleet ship. Vanguard ships in the fleet enjoy up to 7% damage reduction, with DD/CL main guns reaching the 7% easily. She requires a Sakura Empire TB in her first slot for bossing against all armor types.

Hakuhou has top anti-heavy damage but no offensive fleet buffs. She also does about 9% more damage for every other Sakura Empire main fleet ship who reloads at roughly the same time as her. Pairing her with Shinano or Amagi(CV) forms a top anti-heavy fleet. Vanguard ships in the fleet enjoy up to 7% damage reduction, with DD/CL main guns reaching the 7% easily. Before fate simulation, the requirement is stricter. Assume that she has a Sakura Empire plane or another Sakura ship.

Since Hakuryuu is the worst Sakura Empire rainbow CV for bossing, she can be fed by Shinano or Amagi(CV) before you get the others. She doesn't really have any strong synergies, but on the bright side, that means she fits well in any fleet as a transitional option.

Implacable.notes: One of the first Roots in this game, and that’s pretty much the main reason you’d use her as her damage output compared to other UR CVs is significantly lower. Unfortunately, she has not aged well as ships such as Lexington ll and Nahkimov, 2 other ships with roots (albeit conditional ones) have significantly higher damage output. About the only thing Implacable has over those 2 are there are no conditions to fullfill to activate her root.

Kazan.notes: 40% slow, terrible damage for a 2025 SR, but BB healer is interesting

Kearsarge.notes: The only rainbow Aviation Battleship in the game currency, Kearsarge’s loadout is unique among rainbow battleships as she trades her auxiliary gun slot for 4 fighters. This means she’s very lacking in self-defense, making her unsuited for the main campaign (her lack of an aux gun means she can’t kill suicide boats, so you really don’t wanna run her as the flagship, and in campaign carriers tend to be preferred for off-flag, especially in plain heavy content). Her damage against light and medium armor bosses is good and she applies a 4% damage debuff to enemies hit by her main guns (8% if the enemy has been inflicted with an AA stat debuff) though bear in mind her reload stat is low for a UR BB. The main reason you’d run her though is with other Eagle Union Carriers, mainly Lexington and Yorktown 2 as she synergizes very well with them (she has Air Raid Assistance skill but it only activates when she’s run with another USN main fleet). Kearsarge needs an Eagle Union or Northern Parliament main gun and she also needs those factions' fighters in order to apply the shelling buff earlier than the BBs fire however.

Kearsarge greatly buffs carriers when there is another Eagle Union main fleet ship and an AA debuff on the boss. Do not bring another source of Air Raid Assistance as Kearsarge's buff already provides that. She forms an anti-light fleet with Yorktown II, Lexington II, and/or Lion. Kearsarge needs an Eagle Union or Northern Parliament main gun and also prefers those factions' fighters for various self-buffs. Fortunately, the current best bossing fighters happen to be of those factions. Do not expect Kearsarge to deal with suicide boats.

Lexington II.notes:
These ratings assume the condition of AA debuff and 3 Eagle Union ships is not met. Lexington II applies a 40% slow under this assumption. See her pairing for upgrading the slow to a freeze.

Lexington ll is one of the best ships in the game against light armor enemies with good damage against medium armor as well. She can also provide a 4-second root (provided she is sortied with one other EU main fleet and the enemy has had its AA stat debuffed when she launched her airstrike) for the fleet, removing the need to run Implacable or Nahkimov with them. Lexington ll also has a very useful utility in the main campaign. If your fleet shoots down 17 aircraft or she looses 25% of her HP, she gains 1 stack of her blue skill, and once she gains 4 stacks, she can reduce the damage your main fleet takes from enemy aircraft by 100%. This benefit is not relevant in mob battles but is in campaign boss battles. Lexington ll in addition to the AA stat debuff for her root does want to be sortied with 2 other EU ships to proc a 12% damage buff for herself, at least one of which should be a main fleet.

These ratings assume there are 3 Eagle Union ships, including Kearsarge, Yorktown II, or both. Lion can substitute for one of them. There must also be an AA debuff in the fleet, which Yorktown II provides. Lexington II freezes the enemy under these conditions. This forms a top anti-light boss fleet that can also fight medium armor decently.

Lion.notes: One of the most broken ships in the game currently (March 2026). She delivers the highest overall solo damage of any ship in the game. Furthermore, she applies a permanent 10% damage debuff to any enemy afflicted by her burn (which lasts for the duration of the target's life). And to add the cherry on top she is one of the few BBs with salvo capacity +1 so she isn’t affected by absolute cooldowns making her quicker to reload her main guns in practice compared to other BBs. While she may not be the "absolute best" choice for every specific niche or composition, her raw output is so immense that she consistently features in the top three to five meta comps for all relevant content. No other Ultra Rare (UR) dominates the game quite like she does; she is an absolute top-priority investment.

Massachusetts.notes: Needs to NOT use her unique augment against light armor enemies. Augment gives ~26% more damage for M/H.

Masséna.notes: Preload, high light damage, can chain up to three 88% chance barrages.

Mecklenburg.notes: One of the best all around UR BBs in the game currently. She has good damage against light armor and outstanding damage against medium and heavy armor. She’s one of the few BBs with salvo capacity +1 so she isn’t affected by absolute cooldowns making her quicker to reload her main guns in practice compared to other BBs. Her skills do give her a preference to be sortied with Bismarck Zwei for a 15% reload buff for herself and to apply 5% damage debuff for the fleet but this is very much a case of nice to have than an outright necessity for her to perform well.

Top BB damage, especially against heavy. She has a 5% buff for the fleet for 8s when she fires, so she prefers firing first, but 5% may not beat good sync if she can't easily fire first. When synced with Bismarck Zwei, Mecklenburg gives the fleet another up to 5% more damage.

Mikasa.notes: Mikasa is bad at everything besides buffing BBs through a 60% chance and buffing Sakura Empire ships. These ratings assume she is being used to buff non-Sakura BBs. For EX, she should be used purely as a buff bot at level 1. She is also the lowest power BB for filling requirements, beating common rarity BBs.

Mikasa is bad at everything besides buffing BBs through a 60% chance and buffing Sakura Empire ships. These ratings assume she is being used to buff Musashi. For EX, she should be used purely as a buff bot at level 1. She is also the lowest power BB for filling requirements, beating common rarity BBs.

Monarch.notes: Decent slow, small EVA debuff, 100% chance barrage.

Musashi.notes: One of the best battleship in late Main Campaign Stages thanks to her ability to tank damage for the main fleet, if she’s equipped appropriately and sortied with the right ships she can drastically improve the effective HP of your main fleet ships. However, it can also easily get her killed more quickly if appropriate measures are not taken (i.e. giving her defensive gear like a Rudder or Fire Extinguisher and pair her with targeted healers like Cowpens or Aquila, or flagship defenders like Z52 or William D. Porter). Outside of the main campaign though and against single target bosses, her performance (relative to newer UR BBs) is somewhat lacking due in no small part to her low reload stat (for a UR BB) and her requirement for an IJN main gun. The upside to that though is one her best guns for the Main Campaign is a purple gun you can get from tech boxes.

Nagato.notes: Nagato has a decent offensive buff for Sakura Empire ships and a huge offensive buff for Sakura Empire carriers. These ratings assume she's not with any Sakura main fleet ships, and her buff for Sakura vanguard ships is usually not significant.

Nagato has a decent offensive buff for Sakura Empire ships and a huge offensive buff for Sakura Empire carriers. These ratings assume she's buffing two rainbow IJN CVs, which include Shinano, Hakuhou, Amagi(CV), and Hakuryuu. The 20% reload buff enables these CVs to complete 4 airstrikes in META Showdown (80 seconds) without heavily griefing their airplane choices. As a BB, Nagato also enables bringing Trafalgar, or other buffers who require a BB flagship, in the Sakura CV fleet. Note that without a freeze, such a fleet is only good if timed to the boss's natural stop times.

With strong torpedo bombers and weak fighters, she leans to anti-heavy bossing. These ratings assume that she has 2 Sakura friends who aren't carriers.

Unicorn.notes: The best full-vanguard healer as of 2026.

Valiant.notes: A 50% damage barrage, and a debuff that can miss and doesn't apply to the first salvo.

Vanguard.notes: Strong buff for BBs, decent buff for everyone. Has weak crossfleet.

Vestal.notes: Minor heals both inside and outside battle, and +1 ammo is very nice for mob.

Vestal META.notes: Minor heals both inside and outside battle, and +1 ammo is very nice for mob.

Victorious.notes: Assumed to be fighting BB bosses only.

Vittorio Veneto.notes: Assumed to be buffing multiple Sardegna Empire ships.

Volga.notes: Semi-targeted heal that is strong for low HP ships like DDs. Secondary healer, decent damage.

Warspite.notes: A REAL UR NOW. But still the worst UR BB by a little.

Washington.notes: Her sweeping barrage has short range and fails to hit most enemies. Assumed to not be with South Dakota.

Wasp.notes: Lowest power CV for filling requirements. Assumed to not be with a Royal Navy ship, though it doesn't matter either way.

West Virginia.notes: Her 70% barrage with debuffs arrives somewhat late even if she is first to fire. Barely gets a 1 for Offense Buff.

Yorktown II.notes:
These ratings assume that she has an Eagle Union airplane equipped and is sortied with 2 other Eagle ships but she is not with Kearsarge or Yorktown/Essex-class.
Yorktown II is one of the best ships in the game against light armor enemies with excellent damage against medium armor as well. She has a unique ability which allows her to decrease the airstrike cooldowns of Yorktown and Essex class carries in the same fleet as her by 10% when she launches her own airstrike which is very useful for syncing your Yorktown and Essex class ships (and why she prefers to launch first as if she launches after your other Yorktown and Essex class ships her skill causes them to desync) and for getting off 4th airstrikes in META showdowns. Bear in mind however she that she wants to be sortied with 2 other EU ships to proc a 15% AVI and Accuracy buff for herself.

Requires an Eagle Union airplane and 3 Eagle ships. Strong fighters, weak TBs, and a Skyraider barrage make her good against light bosses and poor against heavy bosses. These ratings assume that all conditions are met and she is with Kearsarge, Lexington II, and/or Essex. It's extremely easy to sync Yorktown-class or Essex-class CVs to launch just after Yorktown II because there's a window of 8% or 10% of the reload time.

Yorktown META.notes: zTENTATIVE 10% AA/EVA debuff, buffs any Yorktown, buffs Framework of Logic.

Yoshino.notes: zTENTATIVE Pseudo-healer with high damage but is squishy herself. Random slows.

Yumi.notes: The 2 to 3 second freeze happens too early, so some TBs will miss.

Yumia Liessfeldt.notes: Endemeteo for CV boss dmg. And/or Superior Grimoire for stagger or extra airstrike. Or Granshine for campaign.
Yumia can bring Panacea Sphere as the only item effect to get 2.5% vanguard heal every 8s. Because there is no main fleet healing, you will need a fleet with good AA or anti-shelling.

Zeppy.notes: Assumes there are many KMS ships.

Zuihou.notes: Ryuuhou Pro Max. Asterisk means the fleet is DD/CL or low-HP focused. Like a tanky DD for main tank.

Zuikaku.notes: Prefers 3 Sakura Empire ships. Ramp up time favors longer battles. These ratings assume she is with 3 Sakura ships but not with Shoukaku, missing out on 20% AVI.
